name: Roamer
storyline: The land never ends because it is still being made. The haze on every horizon is its unfinished edge, and the farther you walk from where you started, the newer and stranger the country gets, with tougher beasts and rarer finds. You are a regular settler with a knack for finding treasure. Settlers want the world to stop growing so they can hold it. The gun companies want it to grow forever and race outward to mine the new land. The old peoples of the earlier lands know things nobody else does. And a robed order claims to know what is making the world. Something far out in the haze is doing exactly that.
summary: A first-person open-world shooter and survival game with an inked, comic-book look, set in a land that is still being made and never ends. You start as a settler with nothing: hunt, fish, gather and craft to stay alive, then build. The farther you explore, the stranger the country, the tougher the beasts, and the better the finds, and what you bring back lets you build more, which makes it easier to learn the world's story and to travel it. Guns with real recoil, a grapple, vehicles, factions with their own aims, and a story to uncover across the whole map. Team deathmatch against bots is playable now, online play with friends is next, with a Steam release to follow.
